test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Two trains 280 metres and 260 metres long, respectively, are running towards each other on parallel lines, one at the speed of 58 km/hr and another at the speed of 50 km/hr. How much time (in seconds) will they take to cross each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the first train = 280 metres

Length of the second train = 260 metres

Speed of the first train = 58 km/hr

Speed of the second train = 50 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed</p
